thread:
lina: Hi team, first-day network weirdness. I'm on a company loaner laptop hooked to my phone hotspot (T-Mobile) and using the WireGuard split-tunnel profile. Trying to `docker pull registry.internal.redwood:5000/team/service:latest` and `curl -v https://api.internal.redwood/health` both fail during TLS handshake. Public sites fine. Any quick checks?

infra-jen: welcome! Mobile hotspots sometimes fragment packets or enforce low MTU which breaks TLS over WG. Can you paste `ip link show wg0` and `ifconfig` and the `wg` output? Also try `curl --resolve api.internal.redwood:443:10.50.1.12 https://api.internal.redwood:443/health -v` to avoid DNS oddness.

lina: pasted outputs (trimmed):
```
$ ip link show wg0
4: wg0: <POINTOPOINT,MULTICAST,NOARP,UP,LOWER_UP> mtu 1420 qdisc noqueue state UNKNOWN mode DEFAULT group default qlen 1000
    link/none 

$ ifconfig wwan0
wwan0: flags=4163<UP,BROADCAST,RUNNING,MULTICAST>  mtu 1500
    inet 192.0.2.34  netmask 255.255.255.0  broadcast 192.0.2.255
```
Curl: `* TLSv1.3 (OUT), TLS alert, unknown CA (openssl)` then `curl: (35) error:14094410:SSL routines:ssl3_read_bytes:tlsv1 alert unknown ca` — but I think that's a symptom.

claire: interesting. mtu=1420 on wg0 is already lower than default 1420 vs 1500 but mobile carriers sometimes rewrite packets so you need to pull it down further (1200-1280). Try `sudo ip link set mtu 1280 dev wg0` and test. Also try `sudo sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_mtu_probing=1` to enable MTU discovery.

lina: set mtu 1280, re-ran curl and docker pull — docker now negotiates TLS and pulls layers. Curl health endpoint returns 200. Nice!

security-ops: quick note: if you see "unknown CA" specifically, check whether your hotspot is injecting a TLS intercept (rare) or your company CA not loaded. In this case MTU fix makes sense. For onboarding docs we should include the hotspot MTU tip.

infra-jen: creating INF-1410: "hotspot MTU fragmentation - onboarding loaner laptops" and assigning to eng-infra. Short-term onboarding checklist items: 1) if using mobile hotspot, set wg MTU to 1280; 2) enable TCP MTU probing; 3) use office wifi or wired where possible.

deploy-bot: INF-1410 created: "hotspot MTU fragmentation - onboarding loaner laptops" assigned eng-infra.

lina: thanks everyone! I'll add a one-liner to the new-hire checklist so others don't waste time on this. :raised_hands'
